title: A benched CLI family's provider-stated reset is only free text in the evidence; the canary, preflight and advisor show the capped day, so a two-week wall reads as 'benched until tomorrow' every day
summary: Since 2026-09-30 ParseResetHint reads a dated wall ('try again at Oct 14th, 2026 4:13 PM') and caps benched_until at resetHintCap (a day) so the canary re-checks a long wall daily and notices an early lift; the bench's Evidence keeps the banner (truncated at 160 runes). The stated reset itself is not a field: the canary's 'still walled … re-benched until' line, the preflight cli-health detail and the advisor's CLI-health section all print the capped instant, so an operator or the advisor sees a two-week wall as one day, every day (architecture review of the dated-hint fix, MEDIUM-2). OperatorAction must not carry it: that field means a wall no canary clears on its own.
fix: Split the uncapped parse out of ParseResetHint, add Entry.StatedReset (json stated_reset, omitempty) beside BenchedUntil, and print it in the canary's still-walled line, the preflight detail and the advisor's CLI-health section.
acceptance: A dated wall's bench records stated_reset at the provider's instant while benched_until stays capped at a day
The canary's still-walled line and the advisor's CLI-health section name the stated reset
source: console, 2026-09-30 architecture review of the dated reset-hint fix (MEDIUM-2)
